usage: The word '印尼' (jan3 nei4) is a proper noun used to refer to the country Indonesia.
'印尼' usually comes after a preposition or a verb when talking about traveling or discussing countries.
You can use '印尼' as the subject or object in a sentence when mentioning Indonesia specifically.
When comparing countries, you can pair '印尼' with other country names like '泰國' (Thailand) or '馬來西亞' (Malaysia).
To ask questions about Indonesia, use '印尼' with question words like '去邊度' (where to go) or '有咩' (what is there).
